name: Biceps curl
description: One elbow bends to bring the hand toward the shoulder, then straightens. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Stand side-on to the screen with the working arm nearest the camera.
Start with the arm straight by your side.
Bend the elbow to bring your hand up, keeping the upper arm still.
Straighten the arm back down in a controlled way.

camera.guidance: Turn so the working arm faces the camera. The bend must happen side-on to the camera to be measured.

messages.target_not_reached: Bend your elbow a little further.

form_rules.message: Keep your upper arm still by your side.

setup: Stand side-on to the screen with the working arm nearest the camera.
Let the arm hang straight down, palm facing forward.
If you use a weight, use the one your therapist chose.

cues.start: Arm straight down by your side.
cues.move: Bend your elbow to bring your hand up toward the green line.
cues.back: Lower your hand slowly until your arm is straight.

key_points: Straighten the arm fully between repetitions.
guidance.tempo: About 2 seconds up and 2 seconds down.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
